detail.en: The case-given recovery path opens the Lightkeeper access chain (Network Provider - Part 1).
detail.zh: 交出箱子的取回路線會開啟 Lightkeeper 的接觸任務線（網路供應商 - 1）。

detail.en: Complete the Lightkeeper access chain before recovering the case.
detail.zh: 取回箱子前，先完成解鎖 Lightkeeper 的任務線。

detail.en: Kerman's ending requires BTR Driver reputation; this guide explicitly names the start of that quest chain.
detail.zh: Kerman 結局需要 BTR Driver 聲望；此指南明確指出該任務線的起點。

detail.en: Follow the BTR Driver quest chain through this quest to raise BTR Driver reputation.
detail.zh: 沿著 BTR Driver 任務線做到這個任務，提高 BTR Driver 好感。

detail.en: Do not complete this Skier route for the Kerman ending; the wiki states it redirects the ending.
detail.zh: 若要達成 Kerman 結局，請勿完成此 Skier 路線；wiki 指出此路線會改變結局。

detail.en: Alternative source of the Advanced current converter for the Solar Power prerequisite; quest completion is not mandatory.
detail.zh: 取得直流變壓器的替代來源，可用於滿足太陽能設施的前置需求；不必完成此任務。

detail.en: Find the Lighthouse camp note, unlock Lightkeeper, deliver three Blue Folders, then fire a yellow flare at ULTRA and kill 15 targets in one Interchange raid to recover the case. Open it using Mechanic's Lab jammer and Workbench craft.
detail.zh: 找到燈塔營地的字條，解鎖 Lightkeeper，交付三個 Blue Folders，接著在 ULTRA 發射黃色信號彈，並在單場 Interchange 戰局消滅 15 個目標以取回箱子。使用 Mechanic 的實驗室干擾器與工作台製作配方打開箱子。

detail.en: Ask Mechanic how to open the retained case; obtain the Lab jammer, unlock the case at the Workbench and inspect the instruction and Ticket. Lightkeeper is not required for this recovery path.
detail.zh: 詢問 Mechanic 如何打開留下的箱子；取得實驗室干擾器，在工作台解鎖箱子，並查看指示與 Ticket。此取回路線不需要 Lightkeeper。

detail.en: After failure of the Lab encryption-device search, consult Kerman and Mechanic, wait, pay 40 Physical Bitcoins and retrieve the device from Elektronik's apartment on Streets. Activate the card in the Intelligence Center.
detail.zh: 在實驗室搜尋加密裝置失敗後，諮詢 Kerman 與 Mechanic，等待並支付 40 個實體比特幣，再從 Streets 的 Elektronik 公寓取回裝置。於情報中心啟用卡片。

detail.en: Refuse Kerman immediately after opening the case; test the card on Shoreline. Pay Prapor 300 million RUB if the case was handed over, or 500 million if retained. For the retained-case variant, complete the Lab folders/drive, Streets kills and one-raid PMC kill requirements within 72 hours or hand over Kappa. Receive the introduction letter and enter Terminal.
detail.zh: 打開箱子後立即拒絕 Kerman；在海岸線測試卡片。若已交出箱子，支付 Prapor 3 億 RUB；若自己留下箱子，則支付 5 億 RUB。自己留下箱子的分支須在 72 小時內完成實驗室資料夾／硬碟、Streets 擊殺及單場戰局 PMC 擊殺需求，或交付 Kappa。取得介紹信並進入碼頭。

detail.en: Accept Kerman's help to activate the card, then refuse evidence collection. Talk to Prapor; retained-case requirements include 50 military/electronics items, repair kits and a secure container. Recover the Reserve RB-PKPTS bio-case, pay 1 million USD, then craft the RFID card with Prapor's hash using Solar Power. Enter Terminal.
detail.zh: 接受 Kerman 協助啟用卡片，之後拒絕蒐集證據。找 Prapor；自己留下箱子時，需要 50 件軍用／電子類物品、維修套件和安全箱。取回儲備站的 RB-PKPTS 生物箱、支付 100 萬 USD，再用太陽能發電機以 Prapor 的雜湊製作 RFID 卡，進入碼頭。

detail.en: Continue cooperation and gather eight major evidence items; the 32 minor items are optional for an achievement. Wait 12–24 hours for the contact. Reach Fence 4.0, perform Woods/Reserve cooperative exits in PvP or five PMC kills in one raid on Shoreline and Interchange in PvE, then raise BTR Driver reputation to 0.4. Avoid Choose Your Friends Wisely. Build Solar Power, craft Kerman's card and bring Alpha-1 to Terminal.
detail.zh: 繼續合作並蒐集 8 項重要證據；32 項次要證據只和成就有關，可不做。等 12–24 小時讓聯絡人出現。Fence 好感到 4.0：PvP 在森林／儲備站合作撤離，PvE 在海岸線與 Interchange 各一場擊殺 5 名 PMC；再把 BTR Driver 好感提高到 0.4。避開「識時務者為俊傑」。建好太陽能發電機，製作 Kerman 的卡片，帶 Alpha-1 前往碼頭。

detail.en: Accept Kerman's help, provide some major evidence, then refuse to finish collection. Unlock Lightkeeper through The Ticket or Batya. Obtain topographic documents on Factory, Woods, Lighthouse, Customs and Ground Zero, craft and deliver the data drive, deliver 100 PMC dogtags and kill 30 PMCs on Woods. Collect amulets from marked rooms on Reserve, Streets and Customs, place them in the Lighthouse marked room and receive the Terminal card. This gives the Debtor ending.
detail.zh: 接受 Kerman 的協助，提供部分主要證據，接著拒絕完成蒐集。透過門票或 Batya 解鎖 Lightkeeper。取得工廠、森林、燈塔、海關與中心區的地形文件，製作並交付資料硬碟，交付 100 個 PMC 狗牌並在森林擊殺 30 名 PMC。從儲備站、Streets 與海關的邪教房收集護身符，放入燈塔的邪教房後取得碼頭卡片。此路線通往賴帳者結局。

detail.zh: 在海關工地、森林 USEC 營地或海岸線坦克處找到 BEAR 蹤跡；取得 Bogatyr patch 也能啟動。

detail.en: Finishing the BTR Driver route makes the transport arrangements easier.
detail.zh: 完成 BTR Driver 路線，安排交通會比較容易。

detail.en: The Skier outcome adds ammunition, document-burning and smuggler-territory requirements.
detail.zh: Skier 分支結果會增加彈藥、燒毀文件與走私者地盤的需求。

detail.en: Becomes available after the first return from Icebreaker.
detail.zh: 第一次從破冰船回來後開放。

detail.en: The scientist rescue continues with this quest's 30-Rogue kill stage.
detail.zh: 救援科學家的後續步驟從這個任務的擊殺 30 名 Rogue 開始。

detail.en: Part of the scientist rescue: the Woods and Lighthouse transit markers.
detail.zh: 救援科學家的一部分：森林與燈塔的轉移點標記。

detail.en: Complete the named provisions-and-survival task before continuing the scientist rescue.
detail.zh: 繼續救援科學家前，先完成指定的補給與生存任務。

detail.en: Follow-up quest after entering Icebreaker (BTR negotiations).
detail.zh: 進入破冰船後的後續任務（與 BTR 交涉）。

detail.en: Icebreaker follow-up item-search quest.
detail.zh: 破冰船後續的找物品任務。

detail.en: Named among the Icebreaker follow-up item-search tasks.
detail.zh: 列於破冰船後續的物品搜尋任務中。

detail.en: If Falling Skies ended with the case handed to Prapor, proceed directly to Reserve AMG-10 oil. Prapor arranges evacuation; BTR arrangements are still required for insertion.
detail.zh: 若隕落星辰結束時已將箱子交給 Prapor，直接前往儲備站取得 AMG-10 oil。Prapor 會安排撤離；進入時仍需安排 BTR。

name.zh: Prapor 運輸：已自己留下箱子

detail.en: Hand over three found-in-raid Military power filters, then obtain Reserve AMG-10 oil.
detail.zh: 交付三個在戰局中找到的軍用電源濾波器，接著取得儲備站的 AMG-10 oil。

name.zh: Prapor 運輸：尚未完成隕落星辰

detail.en: Kill 30 targets on Reserve, launch a yellow flare at the Reserve-to-Woods transit, report to Prapor, then obtain AMG-10 oil.
detail.zh: 在儲備站消滅 30 個目標，於儲備站通往森林的轉移點發射黃色信號彈，向 Prapor 回報，再取得 AMG-10 oil。

name.en: BTR transport: sided with BTR Driver
name.zh: BTR 運輸：支持 BTR Driver

detail.en: After finishing the BTR questline on the driver's side, return to the Hideout and visit the driver again.
detail.zh: 完成支持駕駛的 BTR 任務線後，返回藏身處，再次拜訪駕駛。

detail.en: Deliver 200 rounds of 7.62x54R BT, find and burn Skier's Customs documents, and kill 15 targets in the Shoreline/Interchange smuggler territories.
detail.zh: 交付 200 發 7.62x54R BT，找到並燒掉 Skier 在海關的文件，並在海岸線／Interchange 的走私者地盤消滅 15 個目標。

name.zh: BTR 運輸：尚未完成 BTR 任務線

detail.en: Kill 10 targets at the smuggler territories on Shoreline or Interchange, then report to the driver.
detail.zh: 在海岸線或 Interchange 的走私者地盤消滅 10 個目標，接著向駕駛回報。

detail.en: After both transport arrangements, talk to Mechanic. Enter via a hovercraft on Shoreline or Lighthouse using a Sudak-Tudak repair kit. Bring a green flare and 2,500 EUR for evacuation.
detail.zh: 兩邊交通都安排好後找 Mechanic。在海岸線或燈塔用 Sudak-Tudak 維修套件修好氣墊船進入。撤離需要綠色信號彈和 2,500 EUR。

name.en: Blue Fire hacking device not installed
name.zh: 尚未安裝神秘藍焰的駭入裝置

detail.en: Plant the hacking device in The Lab server room and return to Mechanic for the second code fragment. Skip this installation if Blue Fire already completed it.
detail.zh: 在實驗室伺服器室放置駭入裝置，再找 Mechanic 取得第二段代碼。若已於神秘藍焰完成安裝，則略過此步驟。

detail.en: Complete the BTR support chain and deliver the Kirasa-N vest, two compatible class-5+ plates and five respirators; eliminate 20 Icebreaker targets. Return to the scientist and then the driver to obtain C-3; revisit the scientist's room and listen to the tape in the raid. Independently retrieve three C-1 hard drives and deliver three Ultralinks, four Memento RAM modules and two Gigachad processors to Mechanic; read the archive document to finish.
detail.zh: 完成 BTR 支援任務線，交付 Kirasa-N vest、兩片相容的 5 級以上護甲板與五個防毒面罩；消滅 20 個破冰船目標。返回科學家處，再找駕駛取得 C-3；再次進入科學家的房間，並在該場戰局中聽錄音帶。另外取回三個 C-1 硬碟，並向 Mechanic 交付三個 Ultralinks、四個 Memento RAM modules 與兩個 Gigachad processors；閱讀檔案文件以完成任務。
